All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short neatly side-parted SILVER/GREY hair and real grey eyebrow HAIR, clear WHITE/GREY upper-lip MOUSTACHE plus short GREY/WHITE CHIN BEARD. Preserve this real facial hair without turning the yellow anatomy into a pointed long jaw. Serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles or cap. GREY OPEN civilian suit, WHITE/PALE shirt and distinct RED/BURGUNDY patterned necktie beside note. Keep primary near-frontal/mildly angled older appearance, head roll, grey light and crop; no military uniform.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
